description: Land Acquisition - "Vannathithiodai Medathadi" Valikaman West, Poonakari D/S Division - Amendment Homagama D/S Division - Amended No.2104 dated 04.01.2019
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired, their locations, claimants, and extents. It contains multiple notices under Section 7 of the Act regarding government acquisition of land for public purposes, along with corrections and amendments to previous land acquisition notices. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other non-land related administrative matters.
